headline: No Dogs in Space is a music history podcast for true obsessives
summary: The 'No Dogs in Space' music history podcast hasn't released new episodes since July 2024. Season three concluded an abbreviated run focusing on experimental rock. Fans are eagerly awaiting future content from the popular series.

headline: Zuckerberg’s yacht was closer, but someone else saved a stranded boat
summary: An Alaskan cruise ship rescued a skiff stranded near Farragut Bay after running out of fuel. Tracking data revealed Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht, Launchpad, was actually the closest vessel. Despite proximity, the yacht did not participate in the rescue.

headline: 49ers coach says his Tesla was on Autopilot when he crashed
summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan was involved in a car accident four weeks ago in Palo Alto. Shanahan initially took full responsibility for the crash. He recently disclosed that his Tesla's Autopilot feature was engaged at the time of the incident.

headline: Dropbox is a PC builder’s best friend
summary: The author highlights Dropbox as an essential tool for PC builders to protect their work. A personal experience details the anxiety of potentially losing a large crowdfunded game design project. Dropbox is presented as a crucial safeguard against local data loss.

headline: One Night Only Director Cut 'So Much Nudity' from Film Because Audiences Now Dislike Seeing It
summary: Director Will Gluck drastically reduced nudity in his film 'One Night Only.' He believes contemporary audiences have grown uncomfortable with on-screen nudity. This decision reflects a perceived shift in viewer preferences.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3 Ending Explained and Book Differences
summary: The article provides an in-depth explanation of the 'House of the Dragon' Season 3 finale. It details key betrayals, significant deaths, and widespread dragon devastation. Major differences between the show and George R.R. Martin's 'Fire & Blood' are also explored.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3 Finale Recap and Review
summary: This article offers a comprehensive recap and review of the 'House of the Dragon' Season 3 finale. The episode features a spectacular battle, leaving many plotlines unresolved. It sets a thrilling stage for the upcoming final season.

headline: Warner Bros. Stirs Controversy After Posting 'Embarrassing' AI Dog Podcast for The End of Oak Street
summary: Warner Bros. is facing criticism for promoting their new movie, 'The End of Oak Street,' with an AI dog podcast. The promotional tactic has been widely labeled as 'embarrassing.' The move has sparked debate over the use of AI in movie marketing.

headline: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room
summary: A woman alleges Travelodge staff gave her domestic abuser a key to her hotel room. She claims her attacker subsequently kicked her room door off its hinges. The incident raises serious questions about hotel security protocols and guest safety.

headline: Burnham brings forward ban on 'subscription traps' to ease cost of living
summary: Prime Minister Burnham has accelerated plans to ban 'subscription traps' nationwide. The measure is intended to help ease the burden of the cost of living for consumers. This announcement is part of a series of initiatives revealed during a UK tour.

headline: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appears in court after extradition
summary: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan has appeared in court following his extradition from Dubai. The Irish Prison Service acquired a specialized bulletproof and bombproof van for his transport. The 49-year-old's court appearance marks a significant development in his case.

headline: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
summary: Evidence suggesting South African special forces murdered top detective Frans Mathipa has been shared with the BBC. Mathipa was reportedly shot while driving, sparking a major investigation. The prosecution case against eight accused men has been accessed.
